C0523.title: Guangdong Communications Administration Penalizes Apps Violating Personal Information Protection Rules
C0523.summary: In November 2020, the Guangdong Communications Administration issued a notice identifying 88 problematic apps, stating that some apps had security risks such as decompilation and plaintext password storage, and requiring relevant operators to rectify the issues or face administrative penalties. Public reporting listed typical problematic apps including Jietingche, Jiakaojiayuan, and Careland Navigation.
